item.title: Double victory for Northallerton Rugby Club in break from league fixtures
item.description: Northallerton Rugby Club enjoyed a double cup win as both the men’s and women’s first XVs secured victories in their respective competitions.

item.title: Michael Carrick could be in contention for another job if he achieves Man United landmark on Saturday
item.description: Michael Carrick got to know Thomas Frank when they sat down for an interview earlier this season but the Manchester United head coach could put his Tottenham counterpart under more pressure on Saturday.

item.title: Japan taps Meta to help search for abuse of Olympic athletes
item.description: Japan's Olympic committee said on Friday it was working with tech giant Meta to monitor social media around the clock to protect athletes from online abuse at the Milan-Cortina Games.The head of Japan's delegation at the Milan-Cortina Games, Hidehito Ito, asked people to "support the athletes".

item.title: Lakers rally to beat Sixers despite Doncic injury
item.description: The Los Angeles Lakers shook off the early exit of injured star Luka Doncic on Thursday, rallying without him in the second half for a 119-115 NBA victory over the Philadelphia 76ers.LeBron James scored 17 points and handed out 10 assists for Los Angeles, who halted the 76ers' five-game winning streak.

item.title: In Dakar fishing village, surfing entices girls back to school
item.description: For generations, Seynabou Tall's ancestors have fished, dived and rowed off the coast of Dakar, where the 14-year-old, who quit school nearly four years ago, is now learning to surf.- 'We don't have the means' - Like many Lebou, Tall's father is a diver, plunging for fish which have drastically disappeared from Senegal's coast due to industrial trawling.

item.title: Rod Stewart reignites ‘Rangers bias’ row with explosive Scottish referees rant
item.description: Rod Stewart has reignited the long-running debate over refereeing bias in Scottish football after Rangers were awarded an early penalty in their emphatic win over Kilmarnock.

item.title: Neil Featherby: Why real nutrition still beats hype and supplements
item.description: Neil Featherby explains why everyday nutrition matters more than supplements, how carbs fuel endurance, and what runners really need for better performance.

item.title: Henry Pollock interview: I’m happy to be hated if it helps rugby
item.description: Henry Pollock is all smiles. He has just finished one of the most intense training sessions of England’s preparations for their Six Nations opener against Wales, yet you would not know it apart from a cut on his nose.

item.title: Winter Olympics today: Key events in Friday’s schedule and how to watch on TV
item.description: Officially, the 2026 Winter Olympics start on Friday evening at the opening ceremony. In practice, competition began on Wednesday, February 4 when the curling got under way.

item.title: Minehead Women beat Taunton to keep 10-from-10 start going
item.description: Minehead AFC Women 2-0 Taunton Town Women.
